papers.title: UniAction: Unified Action Conditioning for World Models
papers.abstract: Actions that condition world models are highly heterogeneous, and thus existing action-conditioned world models are typically built for individual action types, fragmenting already limited action-annotated data across separate models. We introduce UniAction, a unified action-conditioning framework that represents any action as a sparse set of action elements, each with a discrete semantic identity and a continuous spatiotemporal grounding coordinate. By mapping these coordinates directly into the pretrained video model's native positional space, UniAction allows heterogeneous actions to condition a shared world model within the same spatiotemporal structure. We further introduce cardinality-calibrated attention to address the bias from differing action representation granularities. We evaluate UniAction on four representative action forms: force, camera control, hand pose, and robot pose. UniAction outperforms conditioning alternatives in action following, and a single jointly trained model surpasses the action-specific experts, showing that heterogeneous action data benefit from unified model and joint training.

ai_summary.problem: 现有动作条件世界模型通常只针对单一动作类型构建，导致有限的动作标注数据被分散到不同模型中，难以统一利用异构动作数据。
ai_summary.method: 提出 UniAction 统一动作条件框架，将任意动作表示为稀疏动作元素集合，每个元素包含离散语义身份和连续时空定位坐标；通过将坐标映射到预训练视频模型的原生位置空间，使异构动作在统一时空结构下条件化共享世界模型，并引入基数校准注意力缓解不同动作表示粒度带来的偏差。
ai_summary.result: 在力、相机控制、手部姿态和机器人姿态四类动作形式上，UniAction 的动作跟随效果优于其他条件化方案；单个联合训练模型超过各动作专用专家模型，表明异构动作数据可从统一模型和联合训练中受益。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用稀疏动作元素及其时空坐标将异构动作统一映射到视频模型原生位置空间，实现跨动作类型的统一条件化世界模型。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型统一利用多源异构动作数据提供了新范式，有助于推动多模态动作条件视频生成与具身智能中的通用世界建模。

papers.title: RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
papers.abstract: We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning. With capabilities spanning spatial reasoning, physical prediction, and grounding, RynnUnify connects an understanding of the physical world with visual anticipation of how it evolves across successive subtasks. Building on these capabilities, we further develop an agentic extension through reinforcement learning to selectively use video predictions for reasoning about unobserved states and interaction outcomes. We also develop a world-action extension of the full RynnUnify model, translating its understanding and prediction capabilities into robot control. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Rynn-VP and Rynn-GEU for long-horizon visual planning and anticipatory reasoning. Experiments show that RynnUnify achieves the highest average embodied understanding score among the evaluated unified multimodal models and improves the Rynn-VP overall score by 9.75 points over Cosmos 3 Nano. Its agentic extension improves the Rynn-GEU average by 6.0 points over direct reasoning, while the world-action extension achieves 51.5\% success on 20 selected composite RoboCasa365 tasks and 46.7\% average success across three real-robot tasks. Together, these results establish RynnUnify as a shared foundation for embodied understanding, visual planning, and robot control, taking a step toward a unified embodied brain.

papers.title: Multimodal Generative AI Assists Comprehensive Echocardiographic Interpretation
papers.abstract: Echocardiography is the cornerstone of cardiovascular diagnostics, yet its global utility is constrained by a critical shortage of experienced interpreters. Current artificial intelligence (AI) solutions remain limited, typically operating as opaque "black boxes" or focusing on narrow tasks that fail to capture the holistic, guideline-driven reasoning of a clinician. Here we introduce EchoChat, a generative multimodal vision-language model that performs comprehensive echocardiographic analysis to support clinician interpretation. By emulating the cognitive workflow of a cardiologist, EchoChat integrates vast medical knowledge with a chain-of-thought reasoning mechanism to explicitly ground its conclusions in visual evidence. Trained on echocardiography-instruction pairs from 46,358 examinations, our model establishes a new state-of-the-art across diverse cohorts from six international medical centers. It supports the broadest diagnostic scope of 33 cardiac conditions and findings, including 15 newly added conditions for which it achieves an average F1 of 73.7% across available external evaluations. It surpasses existing best-performing foundation models in cardiac condition recognition (improving average recall by 13.54% on shared tasks) and quantification (average R2 score increase of 0.275 on shared tasks). Furthermore, in a source-blinded echocardiographer reader study, echocardiography reports co-generated with EchoChat were rated higher in diagnostic accuracy and completeness by two senior echocardiographers, and improved diagnostic performance from 72.78% to 82.75% in terms of F1 score over routine-reader only reports. These results demonstrate that integrating clinical reasoning into multimodal AI can democratize specialist expertise and transform the standard of cardiovascular care.

papers.title: Predictive Long-Horizon Progress Modeling with Action-Aware Quantification
papers.abstract: Quantitative and dense task progress feedback is essential for robotic manipulation across data curation, policy evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Existing progress annotations often rely on sparse keyframe markings derived from subjective manual judgments, limiting their scalability and cross-task consistency, particularly in long-horizon manipulation. To overcome these challenges, we propose action-aware quantification, a unified progress specification that decomposes long-horizon trajectories into object-level subtasks via a vision-language model (VLM) and assigns weighted action credits to capture fine-grained execution dynamics. Using VLM auto-labeling and human calibration, we construct an 800+ hour training video dataset and LOOM, a long-horizon progress benchmark containing 19,618 human-calibrated evaluation frames. To model these dense progress dynamics, we introduce NimCritic, a predictive progress critic trained via Joint Video-Progress Learning. We further incorporate Historical Progress Perturbation to mitigate sequential drift, and design a contrastive Video-Progress Alignment objective that bridges asymmetric expert streams by mutually grounding intermediate visual dynamics and denoised progress trajectories. NimCritic matches or outperforms state-of-the-art process reward models (PRMs) on the established Video Progress Benchmark (VPB) and LOOM, surpassing GVL (GPT-6-Sol) on VPB by about 65% in terminal success accuracy (TSA). On the large-scale RoboArena policy evaluation benchmark, it also retrieves human-selected successful rollouts with about 97% overall recall. These results establish action-aware quantification as a scalable foundation for dense progress feedback in robotic manipulation.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人长程操作中，现有任务进度标注依赖稀疏关键帧和主观人工判断，难以扩展且跨任务一致性差，缺乏密集、定量的进度反馈。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出动作感知量化，将长程轨迹通过VLM分解为对象级子任务并分配加权动作信用；构建800+小时训练视频数据集和LOOM基准，并训练预测式进度评论器NimCritic，结合联合视频-进度学习、历史进度扰动和对比式视频-进度对齐。
ai_summary.result: NimCritic在VPB和LOOM上匹配或超过现有过程奖励模型，在VPB终端成功准确率上比GVL（GPT-6-Sol）高约65%；在RoboArena策略评估中以约97%总体召回率检索人类选出的成功轨迹。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出统一的动作感知进度量化规范，并用VLM自动标注与视频-进度联合学习训练密集进度评论器。
ai_summary.relevance: 为机器人操作中的数据筛选、策略评估和强化学习提供了可扩展的密集进度反馈基础。

papers.title: The Answer Knows Where to Look: Zooming before MLLMs Answer under Visual-Token Budgets
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) read images through visual tokens, and under the small per-image budgets that efficient deployment requires, the fine text of documents, charts and infographics becomes illegible. Zooming in recovers the evidence, but the region must be chosen before the model answers. We find that MLLMs know where the evidence is, but not in a form that can be read before they answer: the answer tokens localize it from the middle layers on, whereas the attention available before answering does so only in the top layers, at a depth that varies across models, and diffusely. Supervising the pre-answer attention to point degrades reading, and the benefit of zooming is governed by each image's information gap. Building on these findings, we introduce ours, which lets an MLLM look where its answer would. A dedicated look token, processed in a single prefill and kept out of the answering pass, learns in hindsight to attend as the model's own correct answers do, extracting this knowledge into a concentrated pointer before any answer exists. Its hidden state then selects how to look, from no zoom to crops, square windows, windows that adapt to the pointer and foveated warps, supervised by the counterfactual outcome of every view. ours needs no box annotations, per-model layer search, external localizers or generation before the answer. On Qwen3-VL at three scales and five text-rich benchmarks, it surpasses the strongest baseline by 4.8-9.1 points at 98 visual tokens per view and attention-guided zooming by 11.1-17.0 points, while running faster than attention-guided and grounding-based zooming.

ai_summary.problem: 在多模态大模型受视觉Token预算限制时，文档、图表和信息图中的细粒度文字会变得难以辨认；放大图像虽能恢复证据，但必须在模型作答前选准区域。
ai_summary.method: 论文发现答案Token能在中间层定位证据，而作答前注意力无法稳定读出该位置。为此提出一个专用look token：它在单次prefill中处理且不进入作答过程，通过事后监督学习模仿模型自身正确答案的注意力，将定位知识提取为作答前的集中指针，并由其隐藏状态选择不缩放、裁剪、方形窗口、指针自适应窗口或中央凹变换等查看方式，以每种视图的反事实结果为监督。
ai_summary.result: 在Qwen3-VL三个规模和五个文本丰富基准上，每视图98个视觉Token时，该方法比最强基线高4.8-9.1分，比注意力引导缩放高11.1-17.0分，且运行速度快于注意力引导和基于grounding的缩放方法。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用事后监督的look token把模型“答案知道看哪里”的知识提前转化为作答前可用的定位指针，并据此选择自适应缩放方式，无需框标注、逐模型层搜索、外部定位器或作答前生成。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为视觉Token预算受限下的高效多模态高分辨率阅读提供了新思路，说明可利用模型内部答案定位能力指导作答前视觉取证。

papers.title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
papers.abstract: Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions. Existing robust RL algorithms offer a rich set of mechanisms and principles, yet two major barriers limit their broader potential: limited algorithm reusability and an unclear empirical capability boundary. We introduce RobustRLlib, an algorithm-centric library and benchmark that addresses both challenges. It integrates 17 representative robust online, offline, and safe RL algorithms under a unified interface for substantially improved reusability, together with an enhanced evaluation platform spanning diverse real-world shifts and advanced humanoid and vision-language-action tasks. Systematic evaluation over 273 perturbation configurations provides an up-to-date capability map of current robust RL algorithms, revealing where they remain effective and where substantial robustness gaps persist. As an open-source, user-friendly platform, RobustRLlib offers a reproducible and extensible codebase for applying existing methods to new problems and developing new robust RL algorithms.

papers.title: If at First You Don't Succeed, Backtrack: Lightweight Recovery for Frozen VLAs
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models perform well on robotic manipulation, yet remain brittle once their own actions carry them into states their training data barely covers. Recovering from such failures usually requires recovery demonstrations, policy retraining, or a separate model at inference time. We introduce Backtrack, a lightweight failure detection and recovery mechanism for frozen VLAs that needs none of these. A small failure prediction head, trained only on outcome-labeled rollouts of the frozen policy, reads the VLA's existing internal representations to estimate whether the current episode will fail. When the predicted failure probability exceeds a threshold, a controller pauses the policy, retraces the arm's recently achieved motion, and hands control back to the unchanged policy so it can retry from an earlier configuration. The head adds only 0.48-0.88% to the policy's parameter count. We evaluate Backtrack on LIBERO with three VLAs spanning two action-generation families: SmolVLA and $π$0.5, which use flow-matching action experts, and the autoregressive $π$0-FAST. On LIBERO-Long, the suite of long-horizon multi-step tasks and the one on which all three policies fail most often, Backtrack reduces each policy's failure rate by 19-48%, raising success by up to 7.4 percentage points; on the three shorter suites, where control success is already 85-99%, its effect is smaller. On MetaWorld, all twelve controller configurations tested with SmolVLA improve on the unassisted policy.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中表现良好，但一旦自身动作进入训练数据覆盖不足的状态就容易失败；现有恢复方法通常需要恢复演示、策略重训练或额外推理模型。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 Backtrack，为冻结 VLA 增加一个轻量失败预测头，仅用带结果标签的 rollout 训练，读取 VLA 内部表示估计当前 episode 是否会失败。当预测失败概率超过阈值时，控制器暂停策略、回溯机械臂近期已完成的运动，再把控制权交回未修改的策略，使其从较早状态重试。该头仅增加 0.48%–0.88% 参数量。
ai_summary.result: 在 LIBERO-Long 上，Backtrack 将三种 VLA 策略的失败率降低 19%–48%，成功率最多提升 7.4 个百分点；在成功率已达 85%–99% 的较短任务套件上提升较小。在 MetaWorld 上，SmolVLA 测试的全部 12 种控制器配置均优于无辅助策略。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是无需恢复演示、策略重训练或额外推理模型，仅靠冻结 VLA 内部表示上的轻量失败预测与动作回溯实现即时恢复。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为冻结 VLA 的部署提供了一种低成本、模型无关的故障检测与恢复机制，有助于提升机器人策略在真实长程任务中的鲁棒性。

papers.title: LoCA: Enabling Multi-Modality in Geospatial Location Encoders
papers.abstract: Location encoders map geographic coordinates to high-dimensional descriptors through contrastive alignment with paired Earth Observation imagery. We prove that this construction is structurally limited: any Lipschitz location encoder produces an output of intrinsic dimension at most 2, regardless of architecture or bandwidth, which forces the contrastive loss to strictly exceed its asymptotic optimum. Empirically, joint training also collapses the encoder's embedding covariance to low rank. Although dimension-limited, current location encoders sidestep this spectral collapse by training against a frozen image encoder, which we reinterpret as a covariance regularizer that supplies a high-rank target for the location encoder to fold onto. However, extending this approach to multimodal inputs is challenging, as location encoders should simultaneously map a single location to multiple, potentially incompatible, descriptors. We identify two requirements a regularizer must satisfy for location encoding in multimodal regimes: co-alignment across modalities, since adapters alone cannot align independently pretrained encoders; and high effective rank, since the location encoder inherits its target's spectrum. We propose LoCA (Location Contrastive Alignment), a two-stage pipeline that satisfies both. Stage 1 jointly trains Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 encoders with contrastive learning, producing a co-aligned, high-rank multimodal target. Stage 2 freezes the image encoders and trains a location and a tabular metadata encoder as projection adapters with multi-view contrastive learning. Against five state-of-the-art encoders on 17 tasks ranging from land cover and wildfire forecasting to geophysical, socio-economic, biodiversity and climate applications, LoCA achieves the most task wins, is the only model to outperform every other on a majority of tasks, and wins 68.8% of all per-task comparisons.

ai_summary.problem: 现有地理坐标位置编码器只能通过对比学习对齐单一冻结的遥感图像编码器来获得高秩嵌入目标，扩展至多模态输入时面临模态间无法共对齐与有效秩下降的双重困难。
ai_summary.method: 论文首先从理论上证明任何Lipschitz位置编码器的内在维度至多为2，并指出冻结图像编码器实际上充当协方差正则化器。为此提出LoCA两阶段流程：第一阶段用对比学习联合训练Sentinel-1与Sentinel-2编码器，得到共对齐、高秩的多模态目标；第二阶段冻结图像编码器，用多视图对比学习训练位置编码器与表格元数据编码器作为投影适配器。
ai_summary.result: 在覆盖土地覆盖、野火预测、地球物理、社会经济、生物多样性与气候等17项任务上，LoCA取得最多任务胜出，是唯一在多数任务上超越所有对比模型的方案，逐任务比较胜率达68.8%。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次从内在维度和谱坍缩角度理论刻画位置编码器的结构性局限，并据此设计满足共对齐与高有效秩要求的多模态位置编码训练框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 为地理空间基础模型与多模态表示学习提供了理论洞察和可复用的正则化设计原则，推动位置编码走向多模态、高秩表示。

papers.title: Closing the Modality Gap via Simplex-Constrained Representations
papers.abstract: While multimodal contrastive models like CLIP and CLAP successfully learn shared representations, their embeddings typically exhibit a persistent \emph{modality gap}. We propose addressing this separation through a purely geometric approach: changing the embedding domain from the unit sphere, $S^{d-1}$, to the probability simplex, $Δ^{d-1}$. Although both manifolds share the same intrinsic dimension, the simplex acts as a structural prior; its nonnegative, unit-mass constraints serve as a cross-modal calibration that forces both modalities to ground themselves in the same coordinate system. By attaching lightweight softmax adapters and using Total Variation similarity, we reduce the centroid $\ell_2$ gap by 97--99\% across five multimodal retrieval benchmarks. This confirms that simplicial geometry induces genuine semantic alignment, matching or exceeding the retrieval performance of standard unconstrained models.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态对比模型（如CLIP、CLAP）虽然能学习共享表示，但其嵌入存在持续存在的“模态间隙”，即不同模态的表示在空间中彼此分离。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出一种纯几何方法，将嵌入域从单位球面 $S^{d-1}$ 改为概率单纯形 $\Delta^{d-1}$，利用非负、单位质量和约束作为跨模态校准的先验。通过附加轻量级softmax适配器并使用Total Variation相似度，使不同模态在同一坐标系中对齐。
ai_summary.result: 在五个多模态检索基准上，该方法将质心 $\ell_2$ 模态间隙降低97–99%，同时检索性能匹配或超过标准无约束模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用概率单纯形的几何结构作为跨模态对齐先验，从嵌入域层面直接缓解模态间隙。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态表示学习提供了一种简单且有效的几何校准思路，对CLIP类模型的对齐与检索应用具有潜在价值。

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: On-policy self-distillation enables post-training foundation models without relying on stronger external teachers. However, existing approaches rely on ground-truth question-answer pairs, human-curated problem sets, or other supervised signals. In this work, we reformulate on-policy self-distillation as a self-training framework, driven by self-generated question-answer pairs and privileged reasoning demonstrations. We push supervision to the limit: guided solely by coarse, high-level topic descriptions, the model synthesizes its own curriculum of queries and privileged reasoning traces without access to any human-curated prompts or answers. We find that self-distillation on fully synthetic privileged information enables a model to improve across multiple domains while retaining its capabilities on domains it is not self-trained on. We demonstrate the generality of this framework across text and multimodal domains, achieving consistent self-improvement on standard language benchmarks and Visual Question Answering. Our findings demonstrate that foundation models possess rich latent capabilities that can be amplified without external task supervision or curated problem distributions.

ai_summary.problem: 现有 on-policy 自蒸馏方法依赖真实问答对、人工整理的问题集或其他监督信号，本文希望实现无需外部数据和人工标注的模型自我提升。
ai_summary.method: 论文将 on-policy 自蒸馏重构为自训练框架：仅给定粗粒度主题描述，模型自行生成问答对和带“特权推理”的示范轨迹，并在这些完全合成信息上进行自蒸馏训练。
ai_summary.result: 该方法在多个领域上实现自我提升，同时保持在未自训练领域的能力；在标准语言基准和视觉问答任务上均取得一致的性能改进。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是在没有人工提示、答案或课程分布的情况下，让模型仅凭粗粒度主题自生成课程和特权推理信息，实现数据无关的 on-policy 自训练。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作表明基础模型具有可被放大的潜在能力，为无需外部任务监督的可扩展自我改进提供了新思路，对大模型和多模态模型的后训练有启发意义。

papers.title: Semantic Representation for Agentic Self-Play in Automated Laboratories
papers.abstract: Navigating complex, high-dimensional biological search spaces necessitates scalable physical and computational intelligence to explore beyond local optima through iterative self-play across ideation, experimentation, and automation. Translating experimental designs into reliable physical execution remains bottlenecked by static laboratory automation and unmodeled physical variability. To address this, we introduce VERified Infrastructure for Discovery Laboratories, or VERID, a foundational infrastructure designed to bridge the gap between the high-level reasoning of artificial intelligence (AI) agents and complex, error-prone physical realities of wet labs. VERID is a persistent, high-fidelity semantic digital twin of the laboratory workcell that provides four core services: queryable introspection for agentic reasoning, time-compressed simulation for protocol validation, comprehensive trace persistence for a complete scientific record, and a framework for safe execution.   We present three case studies using aqueous dye and deionized water mixtures to validate the optical and fluidic foundations of VERID. These studies demonstrate how VERID enables pre-emptive detection of critical errors in experimental protocols, stateful mid-run error recovery and post-hoc identification of subtle physical failures. The simulation functions as a discrete accounting engine, allowing agents to safely and inexpensively explore experimental designs in silico and refine experimental strategies through iterative self-play. VERID also captures structured multimodal experimental data for downstream analysis, knowledge mining and agent training. We argue that this semantic layer is an essential prerequisite for deploying autonomous agents in the biochemical and biomedical sciences, ensuring data integrity, operational safety, and paving the way for tackling previously intractable grand challenges in biology.

ai_summary.problem: 论文旨在解决AI智能体的高层推理与湿实验室中复杂、易错的物理执行之间的鸿沟，尤其是静态实验室自动化和未建模物理变异导致的瓶颈。
ai_summary.method: 提出VERID，一个持久、高保真的实验室工作单元语义数字孪生基础设施，提供可查询内省、时间压缩仿真、完整轨迹持久化和安全执行框架四项核心服务，并用染料与去离子水混合案例验证其光学和流体基础。
ai_summary.result: 案例表明VERID能预先检测实验协议关键错误、支持运行中状态化错误恢复和事后识别细微物理故障；其仿真可作为离散核算引擎，让智能体低成本在硅内探索实验设计并通过迭代自博弈优化策略，同时捕获结构化多模态实验数据。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是面向自动化实验室的语义数字孪生基础设施，将AI智能体推理、仿真验证、安全执行与完整实验记录统一起来，支撑智能体自博弈。

papers.title: Adaptive World-Models for Anomaly Recognition (AWARE): A Framework for Robot Dynamics Prediction and Introspection
papers.abstract: Unrecognized anomalies in critical infrastructure can rapidly cascade into catastrophic physical or operational failures. Current anomaly detection approaches often rely on direct access to the monitored system by utilizing onboard sensors, such as motor encoders, to detect anomalous states. However, legacy hardware often lacks these sensors, or strict security protocols may prohibit access altogether. We therefore present AWARE, a world model framework that is capable of anomaly detection using only external camera monitoring via system dynamics estimation and state prediction. Evaluated across 240 real-world robotic crane trajectories, including payload collisions and motor degradations, AWARE demonstrates a 26% improvement in anomaly classification over our strongest baseline under noisy, camera-only state estimation. Furthermore, the inferred dynamics parameter can be decoded to identify the source of faults, localizing the degrading motor with 88% accuracy.

ai_summary.problem: 在无法访问机器人内部传感器（如编码器）或受安全协议限制的场景下，如何仅依靠外部摄像头监控来检测机器人系统异常并定位故障源。
ai_summary.method: AWARE 构建世界模型，通过外部摄像头估计系统动力学并预测状态，从而识别异常；同时将推断出的动力学参数解码，用于判断故障来源。
ai_summary.result: 在240条真实机器人起重机轨迹（含负载碰撞和电机退化）上，AWARE 在噪声摄像头状态估计下异常分类比最强基线提升26%，并能以88%准确率定位退化电机。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出仅依赖外部摄像头的世界模型框架，将动力学估计、状态预测与故障源内省定位统一起来，无需访问机器人内部传感器。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了世界模型在机器人动力学预测、无传感器异常监控和可解释故障诊断中的应用潜力。

papers.title: Retiming Robot Demonstrations with a Learned Speed Prior
papers.abstract: The pace of a robot demonstration is often determined by the teleoperator rather than by the task itself. As a result, the same motion can appear at widely different speeds across demonstrations, and policies trained on such data may inherit operator-specific timing along with task behavior. We propose to learn a speed prior directly from large-scale demonstration data. Given a task instruction, a motion path and the images along it, it predicts a distribution over execution speed along the path, from which a chosen quantile defines a consistent clock for retiming each demonstration. Existing methods derive the acceleration signal from the very data they accelerate, so each new task costs another fit, annotation, or pair of predefined rates. A single trained speed prior instead covers every task in a corpus. We fit a speed prior on both robot teleoperation data and handheld demonstrations in which a human arm, rather than a robot arm, moves the gripper, and use it to retime robot demonstrations to the handheld pace before fine-tuning a vision-language-action policy. For execution, we pair the policy with a real-time optimal-control layer that tracks predicted action chunks under robot constraints using the predicted pace. On 120 RoboLab tasks, policies fine-tuned on our learned clocks succeed more often and move with up to half the jerk compared with policies fine-tuned on the original demonstration timing and uniformly accelerated to the same speed. On a real robot, our policy stacks cups in 3.50s, 1.72$\times$ faster than the default policy's 6.02s while succeeding as often, in 29 of 30 trials. Videos and further material are available at https://mllab.snu.ac.kr/projects/learned_speed_prior.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人示教数据的执行速度往往由遥操作者的习惯决定而非任务本身，导致同一动作在不同示教中速度差异很大，训练出的策略会把操作者的时间节律当作任务行为一并学进去。
ai_summary.method: 作者从大规模示教数据（机器人遥操作数据+人类手持夹爪的示范）中学习一个速度先验：输入任务指令、运动路径及沿途图像，预测沿路径的执行速度分布，取某个分位数作为统一的“时钟”对每条示教重新定时。该先验一次训练即可覆盖语料库中所有任务，无需为每个新任务重新拟合或标注；重定时后的数据用于微调视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，执行时再配合一个实时最优控制层，在机器人约束下按预测节奏跟踪动作块。
ai_summary.result: 在120个RoboLab任务上，用以学到的时钟微调的策略成功率更高，抖动最多降低一半（相比按原始时序微调再均匀加速到同一速度的基线）。在真实机器人上，叠杯子任务耗时3.50秒，比默认策略的6.02秒快1.72倍，成功率相当（30次试验成功29次）。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次从大规模示教数据中学习任务条件下的速度先验，用一个统一模型为任意任务分配一致执行时钟，替代依赖被加速数据自身的逐任务拟合/标注方法。
ai_summary.relevance: 为机器人示教数据的时序规范化与VLA策略的高效平滑执行提供了通用、可扩展的方案，对具身智能与机器人学习有直接价值。

papers.title: DT-JEPA: Learning to Predict Future Representations for Decision-Making
papers.abstract: Decision Transformer (DT) has demonstrated strong performance in various offline reinforcement learning (RL) tasks by conditioning action generation on expected future returns and historical trajectories. However, treating expected future returns as the condition provides an incomplete description of the future, as trajectories with different state transitions and behaviors may share similar returns. Moreover, expected future returns inherently depend on task-specific reward functions, which makes policy learning reliant on reward-labeled datasets and restricts its scalability to tasks with similar but unseen rewards. Recently, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) have emerged as a promising paradigm of self-supervised learning-based world models, which learn predictive representations of future dynamics in latent space rather than reconstructing future states in the original space. Inspired by JEPA, we propose DT-JEPA, an offline pretraining and online fine-tuning framework that learns general knowledge from reward-free offline trajectories and achieves excellent adaptation to unseen tasks. Instead of predicting a single deterministic future embedding, we design a novel probabilistic predictor to model the conditional distribution of future representations in the latent space, thereby capturing both predictive information and uncertainty about future dynamics. Theoretically, we show that 1) the JEPA objective seeks to maximize a variational lower bound on the mutual information between historical representations and future trajectories; and 2) predictive future-conditioned policy learning admits a finite-sample performance bound with an O(N-1/4) estimation term. Experiments on D4RL benchmarks demonstrate that DT-JEPA achieves efficient adaptation across varying offline RL tasks, outperforming traditional DT-based and other offline RL methods.

ai_summary.problem: Decision Transformer 以期望未来回报作为条件，无法完整刻画未来动态，且依赖任务特定奖励函数和奖励标注数据，限制了跨任务泛化。
ai_summary.method: 提出 DT-JEPA：基于 JEPA 的离线预训练与在线微调框架，从无奖励离线轨迹中学习未来潜表示；设计概率预测器建模未来表示的条件分布，以同时捕捉预测信息与不确定性，并进行未来条件策略学习。
ai_summary.result: 在 D4RL 基准上实现高效适配并优于传统 DT 及其他离线 RL 方法；理论上证明了 JEPA 目标最大化历史表示与未来轨迹互信息的变分下界，并给出未来条件策略学习的有限样本性能界。
ai_summary.novelty: 将 JEPA 世界模型与概率未来表示预测结合，用于无奖励离线预训练和未来条件决策，替代传统回报条件。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动了自监督世界模型、离线强化学习与决策 Transformer 的结合，为无奖励预训练和跨任务泛化提供新思路。

papers.title: MiD-VLM: Detecting and Grounding Global Semantic Misinformation in Image-Caption Pairs
papers.abstract: Semantic misinformation can arise when an authentic image is paired with a caption that changes or distorts its narrative. Because the image itself may contain no visible signs of manipulation, methods designed to detect pixel-level artifacts can miss these misleading image-caption pairs. We study this problem using DGM4+, a dataset designed to evaluate the detection of global scene and semantic inconsistencies. We propose a multimodal model that combines image-text representations from SigLIP with visual scene features from DINOv2 through a projection MLP, and adapts Qwen2-VL-7B using LoRA. The model jointly predicts whether an image-caption pair is authentic, identifies the manipulation type, and grounds the misleading caption tokens. On the DGM4+ validation split, the model achieves an F1 score of $0.9679$ for binary authenticity classification. These results suggest that parameter-efficient adaptation of vision-language models is promising for detecting semantic inconsistencies, while also motivating further work on precise token-level grounding.

ai_summary.problem: 论文要解决真实图像配误导性文字说明（图像-文本对）中的全局语义虚假信息检测问题，这类误导不依赖像素级篡改痕迹。
ai_summary.method: 方法融合SigLIP的图像-文本表示与DINOv2的视觉场景特征，经投影MLP后接入Qwen2-VL-7B，并用LoRA进行参数高效适配；模型联合判断图文对是否真实、识别操纵类型，并定位误导性caption token。
ai_summary.result: 在DGM4+验证集上，二分类真实性检测取得0.9679的F1分数；结果表明视觉语言模型的高效适配在检测语义不一致方面有潜力，但token级精确定位仍需进一步研究。
ai_summary.novelty: 将全局场景语义不一致检测与误导性文本token定位统一到一个参数高效适配的多模态模型中。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态虚假信息检测提供了不依赖像素伪影的新思路，对图文一致性与可解释性研究有参考价值。

papers.title: Beyond Discrete Tokens: Preserving Numerical Continuity in Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Objective: To develop a unified vision-language model for prompt-conditioned quantitative ultrasound measurement that addresses the mismatch between continuous measurement targets and discrete token-based numerical prediction. Methods: This article presents HAD-VLM, a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion framework that combines autoregressive text generation with continuous measurement prediction within a shared backbone. Visual prompt tuning adapts the vision encoder to ultrasound images. A diffusion process predicts a five-component representation comprising caliper endpoint coordinates and measurement length. A post-processing strategy combining the proposed coordinate-length consistency mechanism with ensemble prediction is introduced to refine measurement estimates. We evaluate four echocardiographic measurement tasks on EchoNet-LVH, with additional assessments of medical question answering and X-ray vertebral measurement. Results: HAD-VLM achieves mean absolute errors of 1.36, 2.77, 3.05, and 1.16 mm for IVSd, LVIDd, LVIDs, and LVPWd, respectively, reducing errors by 21.4-37.6\% relative to the Vicuna-based autoregressive baseline. It also outperforms fine-tuned Qwen3-VL and direct MLP regression across all four tasks. Medical question answering performance is preserved on the evaluated dataset. For X-ray vertebral measurement, HAD-VLM reduces mean absolute error from 11.4 to 6.7 pixels. Conclusion: Integrating autoregressive language generation with diffusion-based continuous prediction improves quantitative medical image measurement while retaining prompt-conditioned task flexibility. Significance: HAD-VLM provides a unified approach to combining language interaction with anatomically grounded numerical prediction for quantitative medical image analysis.

ai_summary.problem: 医学视觉语言模型通常将数值预测离散化为 token，这与超声等场景中连续测量目标（如卡尺端点坐标、长度）存在本质不匹配，导致定量测量精度受限。
ai_summary.method: 提出 HAD-VLM 混合自回归-扩散框架：在共享骨干中结合自回归文本生成与扩散式连续预测，用视觉提示微调适配超声图像，扩散过程输出由卡尺端点坐标与测量长度构成的五分量表示，并用坐标-长度一致性机制与集成预测进行后处理精修。
ai_summary.result: 在 EchoNet-LVH 四项超声测量任务上 MAE 分别为 1.36、2.77、3.05、1.16 mm，较 Vicuna 自回归基线降低 21.4–37.6%，并优于微调 Qwen3-VL 与直接 MLP 回归；医学问答性能保持，X 射线椎体测量 MAE 从 11.4 降至 6.7 像素。
ai_summary.novelty: 将自回归语言生成与扩散式连续数值预测统一到同一骨干中，用扩散头替代离散 token 化来实现解剖学接地的定量测量。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型处理连续数值/定量输出提供了一条可行路径，对医学影像分析及其他需要精确数值回归的 VLM 应用具有借鉴意义。

papers.title: SPOOK: Sparse Pixel Optimization for Off-Manifold Knowledge in Vision Encoders
papers.abstract: Modern vision encoders are widely used as semantic representations, but the relationship between embedding similarity and human-visible semantics can become unclear far from the natural-image manifold. We probe this regime in a black-box setting by applying sparse pixel edits to blank canvases with a simple pixel-level hill-climbing procedure. Across ImageNet and Flickr30k, we evaluate whether these edited blank canvases can retrieve chosen targets in multimodal contrastive encoders and self-supervised visual encoders. On OpenCLIP, inputs optimized toward class prompts achieve strong top-1 and top-5 targeted retrieval performance; on DINOv3, inputs optimized toward class prototypes achieve high target alignment and near-top prototype ranks. These results show that sparse edits on otherwise blank, visually non-semantic inputs can enter target semantic basins in both language-aligned and self-supervised visual representation spaces. Our findings identify a shared off-manifold failure mode of modern vision encoders and suggest sparse blank-canvas optimization as a simple probe of representation geometry.

ai_summary.problem: 现代视觉编码器在远离自然图像流形时，嵌入相似度与人类可见语义之间的关系可能失效；论文要探究并刻画这种离流形（off-manifold）表示行为。
ai_summary.method: 提出 SPOOK：在空白画布上进行稀疏像素编辑，用简单的像素级爬山搜索做黑盒优化，分别以类别提示词（OpenCLIP）和类别原型（DINOv3）为目标，在多模态对比编码器和自监督视觉编码器中测试目标检索与对齐。
ai_summary.result: 在 ImageNet 和 Flickr30k 上，优化后的稀疏编辑空白画布能显著检索到目标：OpenCLIP 取得较强的 top-1/top-5 定向检索性能，DINOv3 达到较高的目标对齐和接近顶部的原型排名。
ai_summary.novelty: 揭示了语言对齐与自监督视觉编码器共享的离流形失效模式，并提出用稀疏空白画布优化作为探测表示几何的简单黑盒方法。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于理解视觉编码器表示空间的几何结构与鲁棒性边界，并为评估多模态和自监督模型的语义对齐提供新探针。
ai_summary.org: 密歇根州立大学（Michigan State University）

papers.title: Video-MemComp: Taylor-Guided Sensitivity-Aware Memory Management for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of video data has created an urgent need for efficient video understanding systems that can handle long and continuous visual inputs, posing significant challenges for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) due to severe memory bottlenecks. Moreover, existing compression methods often overlook the explosive accumulation of approximation errors. To address this issue, we propose Video-MemComp, a training-free and sensitivity-aware context management framework for memory-constrained streaming video understanding. Our method theoretically decomposes compression error into orthogonal local approximation error and layer-wise structural sensitivity via a first-order Taylor expansion. To minimize local approximation error, we perform token aggregation in a pre-RoPE safe zone with an attention-conserving logit bias, mitigating geometric distortions caused by RoPE rotations. To manage layer-wise structural sensitivity, we dynamically allocate the KV cache budget based on offline gradient priors and online context entropy, prioritizing high-sensitivity layers. Video-MemComp outperforms or achieves performance comparable to full-cache and state-of-the-art compression methods on benchmarks including MLVU, VideoMME, and EgoSchema. Notably, it improves the overall accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-3B from 62.3% to 64.1% while reducing the KV cache to an equivalent of 6,000 tokens per layer, saving over 90% of KV memory.

ai_summary.problem: 流式视频理解中，MLLM 面临严重的 KV cache 内存瓶颈，而现有压缩方法忽视了近似误差的爆炸式累积问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出免训练、感知敏感度的上下文管理框架 Video-MemComp：用一阶泰勒展开将压缩误差分解为正交的局部近似误差与层级结构敏感度两部分；局部误差通过在 RoPE 旋转前的安全区做 token 聚合并施加注意力保持的 logit bias 来抑制几何失真，层级敏感度则依据离线梯度先验与在线上下文熵动态分配各层 KV cache 预算，优先保障高敏感层。
ai_summary.result: 在 MLVU、VideoMME、EgoSchema 等基准上性能超越或持平全缓存与 SOTA 压缩方法；Qwen2.5-VL-3B 整体准确率由 62.3% 提升至 64.1%，同时将 KV cache 压缩至每层约 6,000 token 等效规模，节省 90% 以上 KV 内存。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次用泰勒展开将压缩误差显式拆解为局部近似误差与层间敏感度两项，并分别用 RoPE 前安全区聚合和梯度先验+上下文熵的动态预算分配加以优化。

papers.title: When Human Corrections Travel: Safety in Federated VLA Adaptation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can adapt to local human intervention, while federated learning can combine distributed robot experience without pooling raw records. We examine their prospective intersection: sharing adaptations derived from diverse human corrections across tasks, environments, people, and robot embodiments. Corrections differ in modality, safety semantics(urgency, behavioral scope, etc.), and privacy sensitivity. A shared update that improves mean task success may suppress a rare safety intervention or produce an unsafe response on another robot. We argue for three requirements: preserve the context and uncertainty of multimodal corrections when deciding what to share; assess candidate updates in each receiving robot's closed loop before deployment; and evaluate leakage alongside retention of safety-critical evidence. Immediate, legible defensive behavior remains necessary during human interaction. We offer counterexamples and a falsifiable evaluation agenda, not experimental results.

ai_summary.problem: 论文关注 federated VLA 适配中，来自不同任务、环境、人和机器人本体的多样化人类纠正被共享后，可能带来安全语义丢失、稀有安全干预被抑制及隐私泄露等问题。
ai_summary.method: 这是一篇立场/议程论文，而非实验论文：作者提出三项要求——共享时保留多模态纠正的上下文与不确定性；在接收机器人闭环中评估候选更新后再部署；同时评估安全关键证据的保留与泄漏。
ai_summary.result: 论文没有实验结果，主要结论是联邦 VLA 适配不能只优化平均任务成功率，必须把人类纠正的安全语义、接收端闭环安全和隐私泄漏纳入评估，并保持人机交互中的即时可理解防御行为。
ai_summary.novelty: 创新点在于将联邦 VLA 适配与人类纠正的多模态安全语义及隐私问题结合，提出可证伪的安全评估议程和反例。
ai_summary.relevance: 对具身智能和机器人 VLA 的联邦学习安全部署具有方向性意义，提醒领域关注共享纠正更新时的安全与隐私风险。

papers.title: SP-Guide: Enhancing Aerial Vision-Language Navigation with Spatial Priors
papers.abstract: Aerial vision-language navigation (AVLN) requires a UAV to reach a language-described target from partial egocentric observations while reasoning over large outdoor scenes. Existing approaches typically fuse view-centered RGB observations and globally anchored history maps as generic visual embeddings, leaving cross-modal spatial alignment to be learned from sparse navigation supervision. We present SP-Guide, a transformer- based goal-prediction framework that addresses this weakness of alignment through a Spatial Prior Cross-Modal Encoder, an Instruction Enhanced Decoder, and a Goal Convergence Filter for terminal target refinement. Experiments implemented on the CityNav benchmark show that SP-Guide improves success rate over the representative baselines, with the largest gains on unseen environments. These results indicate that physically grounded spatial priors provide an effective inductive bias for robust AVLN.

ai_summary.problem: 空中视觉语言导航（AVLN）要求无人机仅依赖部分第一人称视角的观测，在大型户外场景中理解语言描述并抵达目标。现有方法通常把以视角为中心的RGB观测和全局对齐的历史地图直接融合为通用视觉嵌入，导致跨模态空间对齐只能从稀疏的导航监督中隐式学习。
ai_summary.method: 提出 SP-Guide，一个基于 Transformer 的目标预测框架，包含三个核心组件：空间先验跨模态编码器（Spatial Prior Cross-Modal Encoder），利用物理上可解释的空间先验显式对齐视觉与语言模态；指令增强解码器（Instruction Enhanced Decoder），强化语言指令的引导作用；目标收敛过滤器（Goal Convergence Filter），对终端目标位置进行精细化修正。
ai_summary.result: 在 CityNav 基准上的实验显示，SP-Guide 相比代表性基线提升了成功率，且在未见过的环境中提升幅度最大，表明物理上可解释的空间先验是提升 AVLN 鲁棒性的有效归纳偏置。
ai_summary.novelty: 该框架将显式的空间先验注入跨模态编码过程，而不再依赖数据驱动的方式隐式学习跨模态空间对齐，从而提升了跨模态对齐质量与目标预测精度。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能中的无人机视觉语言导航提供了一种利用显式空间先验提升跨模态对齐与泛化能力的思路，对多模态大模型与具身Agent的空间推理研究具有参考价值。

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日20篇论文中多模态方向占压倒性多数（13篇），且重心明显从“感知”转向“具身行动”：统一动作条件化的世界模型（UniAction）、统一具身大脑（RynnUnify）、冻结VLA的失败回溯恢复，构成一条“世界模型+VLA”主线。另一条主线是跨模态表征的几何与效率问题，包括模态间隙的单纯形约束、位置编码谱坍缩分析、流式视频记忆压缩，以及MLLM作答前的自适应缩放定位。整体呈现“从语言理解走向视觉-动作决策、从堆数据走向表征结构与推理时计算”的迁移趋势。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日论文数据中未包含任何大厂（如Google、Meta、OpenAI、阿里、字节等）的论文条目，机构字段基本为空，因此不存在可识别的大厂方向重合，也就无从比较方法异同与竞争互补关系。从选题看，这批工作更多来自高校与实验室的具身智能、多模态基础研究，与工业界当前聚焦的统一具身基座模型、流式视频理解两条产品化路线高度相关，属于学术侧先行探索。
daily_insight.signals: 值得关注的有三点：一是多模态论文占比异常高（13/20），纯LLM工作仅1篇，研究资源明显向视觉-语言-动作迁移；二是世界模型与VLA结合密集出现（UniAction、AWARE、DT-JEPA、Lightweight Recovery），其中“冻结VLA+轻量失败预测与动作回溯”代表低成本落地思路，可能成为不重训策略的实用范式；三是表征几何层面的理论工作集中冒头（单纯形约束消除模态间隙、位置编码谱坍缩、视觉编码器离流形失效、稀疏画布探测），这类“诊断+几何先验”研究往往是下一波对齐方法的前置信号。此外，医疗多模态（超声心动图、医学数值连续性）形成小型集群，提示垂直领域生成式AI正在补足定量输出能力。
daily_insight.overlap_topic: 无（今日无论文来自大厂，不存在可识别的重合方向）
